Protest by Cockroach Janta Party Raises Concerns Over Violence

The Cockroach Janta Party has organized a protest in support of Prime Minister Modi, but some outlets have raised concerns about the potential for violence. The party's spokespersons have made statements that could be interpreted as inflammatory, leading to speculation about their intentions. The government and critics are watching the situation closely.
